people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
translations.bsb: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
